title: OpenAI's New AI Costs 10 Cents Per Million Tokens
description:
OpenAI's new GPT-6 Luna model runs a million tokens for ten cents - about half of last gen's price, hours after Anthropic cut Claude's price too. Full numbers, sourced from OpenAI's own pricing page today. #Shorts #ai #aitools

No affiliate/sponsored links in this video - pricing verified directly on OpenAI's site the day this was made.
